checks.name: Wasm computed integer with WASI output
checks.code:
;; Wasm arithmetic with real WASI output
(module
  (import "wasi_snapshot_preview1" "fd_write"
    (func $write (param i32 i32 i32 i32) (result i32)))
  (memory (export "memory") 1)
  (func (export "_start") (local $n i32)
    (local.set $n (i32.mul (i32.const 7) (i32.const 7)))
    (i32.store (i32.const 0) (i32.const 16))
    (i32.store (i32.const 4) (i32.const 3))
    (i32.store8 (i32.const 16) (i32.add (i32.const 48) (i32.div_u (local.get $n) (i32.const 10))))
    (i32.store8 (i32.const 17) (i32.add (i32.const 48) (i32.rem_u (local.get $n) (i32.const 10))))
    (i32.store8 (i32.const 18) (i32.const 10))
    (drop (call $write (i32.const 1) (i32.const 0) (i32.const 1) (i32.const 8)))))
